flank.title: Flank length (bp)
flank.description: Half-width of the window centred on each TSS.

bin_size.title: Bin size (bp)
bin_size.description: Bin width; flank must be a multiple of this value.

min_mapq.title: Minimum mapping quality
min_mapq.description: Fragments from reads below this MAPQ are ignored.

exclude_duplicates.title: Exclude duplicate reads
exclude_duplicates.description: Skip records carrying the duplicate flag (0x400).

max_records.title: Maximum records
max_records.description: Stop after this many fragments (0 = no limit).

tss_region_dim.title: TSS region dim
tss_region_dim.description: Record axis of the TSS BED Form.

tss_field_dim.title: TSS field dim
tss_field_dim.description: Field axis of the TSS BED Form.
